home.howHelpsTitle: How TravelSathi Empowers Your Live Journey
home.howHelpsSubtitle: TravelSathi does not abandon you after you book. It adapts continuously during your trip.
home.liveTripModeDesc: Changes from planning into active travel-assistance. Displays your current activity, next stop, local weather, crowd density, and safe walking route with zero cognitive friction.
home.smartDelayDesc: Stuck in mountain traffic or lingering at a tea stall? One tap dynamically recalculates the rest of your day, shifts dining reservations, and ensures a relaxed evening return.
home.weatherAwareDesc: If unseasonal afternoon rain is predicted, outdoor hikes automatically swap with indoor craft workshops, museums, and cozy cafes, returning outdoor trails once the skies clear.
home.safetyTitle: Travel Safely Across Any Indian Region
home.safetySubtitle: TravelSathi integrates certified 24/7 tourist helplines (1363), National Emergency (112), Women Safety (1091), live weather advisories, and single-tap Emergency Mode with GPS coordinate sharing.

home.whyTrustSubtitle: Built as a zero-commission National Digital Public Infrastructure for responsible tourism
home.empoweringCommunitiesSubtitle: TravelSathi is designed to divert tourist footfall from over-saturated hotspots into thriving local community economies.
home.statOtaDesc: 100% of tariff goes directly to verified rural hosts.
